title: Reflection of coherence by a coherent conservative inverse image
statement: Let $u:\mathcal E'\to\mathcal E$ be a coherent conservative geometric morphism between coherent Grothendieck topoi, with all these terms defined in [def-trf-coherent-topos]. For every object $A\in\mathcal E$, if $u^{-1}A$ is coherent in $\mathcal E'$, then $A$ is coherent in $\mathcal E$.
